restoration_note: The teaching describes why the illumining principles within the soul do not yet rejoice wholly: they see both the self seated arrogantly as if it were king of upper and lower, and the living soul stretched, afflicted, transferred body to body, until at the consummation Death (their enemy) is bound in the bolos. Editor proposals are mostly accepted: short morphological completions across line breaks, the standard 'stand on their feet' formula, the second-reason (ⲧⲙⲁϩⲥⲛⲉⲩ) ordinal, and the eschatological binding-in-the-bolos motif at gap 29. Gap 20 (partial ⲥⲁ_ _ϩ) is read as ⲥⲁⲛⲁϩ 'bond' — fitting the spiritual image of the soul 'drawn taut and standing fast in a great bond' between upper and lower place. Gaps 6-8 (the predicate of the luminaries beyond 'casting no shadow') and gap 22 (a 4-char clause opener before 'in every affliction') are too weakly constrained and left unrestorable.

coptic_restorations.basis: Editor restoration. ⲩ[ⲁ]ⲟⲩⲉ = ⲗⲁⲟⲩⲉ 'anyone' with elided ⲗ; the negation ⲙⲛ̄ + indefinite gives 'there is no one'.

Editor restoration of relative-locative 'who is in'. The structural arc demands a relative clause modifying ⲣⲱⲙⲉ: 'no one of men [who is in] the world standing fast in agreement'. Tentative form but spiritually constrained.
Editor restoration ⲍⲛ̄ (Lyc. for ϩⲛ̄) 'in', completing the locative phrase ⲍⲛ̄ ⲟⲩⲧⲱⲧ 'in an agreement'.
Editor restoration ⲟⲩⲧⲱⲧ 'an agreement, accord' — the structural concord by which the world stands fast on its feet (cf. accumulated formulaic vocabulary).
Editor restoration. ⲡⲣⲉⲱⲉ = Lyc. form of ⲡⲣⲁϣⲉ 'joy' (= ⲣⲁϣⲉ in lexicon as ⲡⲣⲁϣⲉ). The agreement of joy lasting until the end fits the chapter's spiritual frame on conjunction.
Editor restoration completing ⲣⲱⲙⲉ 'men' across line break. The 'not only ... but also' structure (ⲟⲩ ⲙⲟⲛⲟⲛ ... ⲁⲗⲗⲁ) demands the second member to begin here with ⲡⲕⲉⲣⲏ 'also the sun'.

3-char gap with no preserved trace at start of a clause about the sun, moon, and luminaries. Could be a subject pronoun ('they too') or a verb particle, but no formula constrains it. Honestly unrestorable.

5-char gap with partial 'ⲉ . . ⲏⲧⲉ'. Possibly ⲉⲣⲏⲧⲉ/ⲟⲩⲣⲏⲧⲉ-related ('feet') if echoing the 'stand on their feet' formula, but the trace is ambiguous and no clean reconstruction fits character count + spiritual frame.
2-char gap with no trace. Could be ⲟⲛ 'also' or a circumstantial particle, but unconstrained.
Editor restoration. [ⲁ]ⲍⲉ ⲁⲣⲉⲧⲟⲩ = ⲁϩⲉ ⲉⲣⲁⲧⲟⲩ 'they stand on their feet' — the recurrent standing-formula of this teaching (cf. line 4 ⲉϩⲁⲍⲉ ⲁⲣⲉⲧϥ̄).
Editor restoration completing ⲥⲱⲧⲙⲉ 'Hear!' — standard imperative opening of a turn in the kephalaia exhortation, with ⲧⲙⲉ visible.
Editor restoration completing ϩⲟⲗⲟⲧⲉⲗⲱⲉ̄ (= Greek ὁλοτελῶς 'wholly') split across line break; ⲉ̄ visible at start of next line.
Editor restoration completing ⲥⲉⲙⲟⲩϩ 'they are filled' (with ϩ visible). The idiom ⲙⲟⲩϩ ⲛ̄ⲥⲱ⸗ = 'be filled with regard to / preoccupied with'.
Editor restoration completing ⲥⲉⲛⲉⲩ 'they see' (with ⲉⲩ visible). They see the enemy set near as a king-face — the self sighted as if it ruled.
Editor restoration completing ⲡⲥⲁⲛⲧⲡⲉ 'the upper place' across line break, paired with ⲡⲥⲁⲛⲙ̄ⲓ̈ⲧⲛⲉ 'lower place' that immediately follows. Standard cosmological pair in this corpus.
Editor restoration completing ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'forth' across line break with ⲃⲁⲗ visible at start of line 14. The phrase ⲟⲩⲃⲱⲗⲧ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ = 'a release-forth / open license'.
Editor restoration completing ⲛϩⲏⲧ 'of heart' in the idiom ⲡⲉϩⲱⲕ ⲛ̄ϩⲏⲧ 'his heart's desire'.
Editor restoration completing ⲧⲙⲁϩⲥⲛⲉⲩ 'the second [reason]' — ordinal opening the second member parallel to ⲟⲩⲉ ⲙⲉⲛ ('on the one hand') above. Structural pivot of the discourse.
Editor restoration of [ⲁ] beginning ⲁⲣⲁⲥ 'to her' (the living soul), split across line break with ⲣⲁⲥ to follow.
Editor restoration completing ⲁⲣⲁⲥ 'to her' from previous line; ⲥ visible. The illumining ones see her — the living soul (ⲧⲯⲩⲭⲏ ⲉⲧⲁⲛϩ̄).

Partial ⲥⲁ...ϩ with ~2 chars missing in middle. Reading ⲥⲁⲛⲁϩ (Lyc. for ⲥⲛⲁϩ) 'bond/chain' — the soul 'drawn taut and standing fast in a great bond' fits both the apparatus and the spiritual image: she is held in a great bond stretching between upper and lower place, between tree and thorn (the next line's locative pair). Lexicon entry bond/chain = ⲡⲥⲛⲁϩ.
Editor restoration completing ⲡⲥⲁⲛⲧⲡⲉ 'the upper place'; ⲡⲉ visible. Cosmological pair with ⲡⲥⲁⲛⲙ̄ⲓ̈ⲧⲛⲉ 'lower place' immediately following.

4-char gap with no trace, opening a clause that continues the suffering-of-the-soul cascade ('in every affliction, oppressing, abusing, tearing, eating'). Could be a circumstantial subject form ('she being') or another locative pair, but unconstrained.
Editor restoration completing ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲥ 'her' (from preceding ⲙⲁ-) plus the circumstantial ⲉ-prefix of ⲉⲩⲃⲁⲭⲝ̄ that follows.
Editor restoration of circumstantial subject prefix ⲉⲩ- on ϣⲱⲗ 'plunder', matching the chain of ⲉⲩ- circumstantials describing the soul's bondage.
Editor restoration completing ⲙⲉⲣⲓⲧ 'beloved' (qualitative); ⲙⲉⲣⲓ visible. The soul is the beloved before them and honored by them — cf. lexicon ⲡⲙⲉⲣⲓⲧ 'beloved'.
Editor restoration completing ⲛⲑⲗⲓⲯⲓⲥ (Greek θλίψις, 'afflictions') split across line break; ⲛⲑ on this line, ⲯⲓⲥ on the next. Lexicon: tribulation = ⲑⲗⲓⲯⲓⲥ.
Editor restoration completing ⲉⲩⲣⲉϣⲉ 'they rejoicing' (circumstantial); ⲉ at start and ⲉϣⲉ at end visible. The illumining ones rejoicing-not-wholly is the structural keynote of the whole teaching.
Editor restoration completing the preposition ϩⲙ̄ before ⲡⲉⲧⲉ ⲡⲧⲱϩ ⲉⲛ ⲡⲉ 'in that which befits not' — the self seated where it has no business being.

Editor restoration of the standard eschatological motif: at the end the enemy (Death/Hyle, the self) is gathered and bound forever in the bolos, the gathered mass of self-love sealed off. Lexicon: bolos = ⲡⲃⲱⲗⲟⲥ — 'the place where the self is finally bound at the end of regeneration'.
Editor restoration completing ⲁⲧϩⲁⲏ (= Sah. ⲉⲡϩⲁⲏ) 'at the end'; ⲁⲧ on this line, ⲏ visible at start of next. Eschatological terminus: the moment when the enemy is bound at the end.
Editor restoration completing ⲙ̄ⲡⲓⲛⲉⲩ 'this moment' across line break; ⲙ̄ⲡⲓⲛ visible. 'They shall not give ear to grief any more from this moment on'.

Editor restoration completing ⲭⲛ̄ ⲛ̄ϣⲁⲣⲡ 'from the first/beginning' — the illumining principles return to the very condition they have always existed in, from the beginning and forever. Structural inclusio with the teaching's opening cosmology.

english_restorations.basis: ⲙⲛ̄ + ⲗⲁⲟⲩⲉ = 'there is no one (of men)'. The negative-indefinite formula opens the teaching: no human stands outside this cosmic situation.
Editor's tentative reading of the relative-locative ⲉϩⲩⲟⲟⲧ ⲍⲙ̄ as 'who is in', modifying ⲣⲱⲙⲉ. Spiritually constrained: every human stands inside the structured world.
ⲍⲛ̄ (Lyc. ϩⲛ̄) 'in' completes the locative phrase 'in an agreement of...'.
ⲟⲩⲧⲱⲧ 'agreement, accord' — the structural concord under which the world stands fast.
ⲡⲣⲉⲱⲉ = Lyc. ⲡⲣⲁϣⲉ 'joy'. Lexicon: ⲡⲣⲁϣⲉ = the state of conjunction realized.
Morphological completion of 'm-' + 'en' = 'men' across line break (Coptic ⲣⲱⲙⲉ split).
Coptic gap unrestorable; English has no anchor.

ⲥⲉⲙⲟⲩϩ ⲛ̄ⲥⲱ⸗ = 'they are filled with regard to / preoccupied with' — the illumining ones cannot look away from the enemy.
ⲥⲉⲛⲉⲩ 'they see' — the illumining ones see the enemy seated as if king.
ⲡⲥⲁⲛⲧⲡⲉ 'the upper place', paired with ⲡⲥⲁⲛⲙ̄ⲓ̈ⲧⲛⲉ 'lower place' immediately following.

Morphological completion of 'de-' + 'sire' across line break (Coptic ⲛϩⲏⲧ in idiom 'his heart's desire').
ⲧⲙⲁϩⲥⲛⲉⲩ 'the second [reason]' — ordinal pivoting from the first reason (ⲟⲩⲉ ⲙⲉⲛ) to the second.
ⲁⲣⲁⲥ 'to her' — single Coptic word split across line break (gap 18 = ⲁ at end of section 5082, gap 19 = ⲣⲁ at start of 5083); one English word 'her' covers both.
ⲥⲁⲛⲁϩ (Lyc. ⲥⲛⲁϩ) 'bond/chain' — the living soul drawn taut and held fast in a great bond between upper and lower. Lexicon: bond/chain = ⲡⲥⲛⲁϩ, 'what holds the soul in a state'.
ⲡⲥⲁⲛⲧⲡⲉ 'the upper place', paired with ⲡⲥⲁⲛⲙ̄ⲓ̈ⲧⲛⲉ 'the lower place' that follows.
Coptic gap unrestorable; the English-side opener of the affliction-clause cannot be supplied.

english_restorations.proposed_english: and they shall bind him in the bolos
english_restorations.basis: Standard eschatological completion. Lexicon: bolos = the place where the self is finally bound at the consummation, the gathered mass of self-love sealed off forever.
ⲁⲧϩⲁⲏ 'at the end' — the eschatological terminus when the enemy is bound. The 'ⲏ' visible at the start of the next line completes the word; English 'end' covers the whole.
Morphological completion of 'mom-' + 'ent' = 'moment' across line break (Coptic ⲙ̄ⲡⲓⲛⲉⲩ split).
ⲭⲛ̄ ⲛ̄ϣⲁⲣⲡ 'from the first/beginning' — the illumining principles remain in the very condition they have existed in from the beginning and forever (structural inclusio).
